t-henri-galactique-02.title: Gyra, Twilight
t-henri-galactique-02.material: Aerospace titanium (Grade 5), 18K gold plating, Muonionalusta meteorite
t-henri-galactique-02.story: T Henri × Maison Galactique. A limited batch of 149, built with construction never before seen in eyewear: aerospace titanium (Grade 5) and plant-based acetate, custom titanium front decors plated in 18K gold, and a hand-set Muonionalusta meteorite stone, ethically sourced, precision cut, etched and electroplated in silver and platinum. The Protoplanetary core wire, the Interplanetary Rocket Cap with its jewel case, and a custom 7-barrel hinge. Hand-polished in Japan.
